concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-004 (multicollinearity diagnostic measured against VIF threshold with descriptive joint interpretation) is not explicitly addressed in the plan. The VIF‑pair flag report (T013/T014) is linked only to FR‑005; the plan does not state that the VIF threshold will be measured and that any exceeding pair will be reported with a joint interpretation, as required by SC‑004.

Task T040 (create figures) has no associated FR or SC in the specification. While useful, it constitutes over‑reach beyond the stated requirements and should be either linked to a relevant FR/SC or removed.
